Package com.example.impact.utils.role

Class EntrantDb

java.lang.Object
com.example.impact.utils.role.EntrantDb
public final class EntrantDb extends Object
Collection of Firestore helpers that power all entrant-facing behavior.

Every method in this class reads or mutates the events/{eventId} subtree or the top-level users/ collection on behalf of the currently authenticated entrant. Controllers and fragments should use these helpers instead of constructing Firestore paths.
